points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in data-driven insights.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for client solutions.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable analytical outputs.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing processing overhead by ~80% per query and enabling efficient handling of large datasets.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, demonstrating capability in solving complex business problems.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable ML models using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for data science applications.
